text: זְכֹר יֶלֶד נוּן. וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי אוּרִי אַפְנוּן. יִזְכְּרוּ בְרִנּוּן. פְּלָאָם לִזְכֹּר: יָקֹשׁ בָּרָק הַשָּׁנוּן. אִם הֻשְׁלַף לְתַאֲנוּן. יַקְשִׁיב תַּחֲנוּן. חֲנוּנָיו לִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר מַעַשׂ שֹׁפְטִים. וְאוֹת קוֹצֵר חִטִּים. מַעַשׂ שׁוֹטִים. יֶחְדַּל מִלִּזְכֹּר: טוֹרַח אַרְבַּעַת שְׁבָטִים. אִם נִגְעֲשׁוּ נִשְׁפָּטִים. טִבְעֵי מִשְׁפָּטִים. אֲשֶׁר שָׂם יִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר חֲצוֹת לַיְלָה. וְתוֹרוֹת מִשְׁפְּטֵי לַיְלָה. חָשֵׁךְ בְּאִישׁוֹן לַיְלָה. נִגּוּנוֹ לָמוֹ יִזְכֹּר: חֵקֶר מִפְקַד לַיְלָה. יָגִיהַ בְּלַבַּת לַיְלָה. חֹק הָגָה יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה. לְגִהוּתָם יִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר זֶה זְבוּל. אֲשֶׁר בְּבִצְעִי חָבוּל. וּזְדוֹנוֹת סָבוּל. עוֹד בַּל יִזְכֹּר: זַעַם כַּמַּבּוּל. אִם יָצְאָה לְחַבּוּל. וְזֵכֶר יֶרַח בּוּל. לְחֶמְלָה יִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר וְכֹחַ

דֶּלֶת. בְּעַד תְּמִימִים בָּעַם. עַד בֹּא קִצָּם. צֵאת לְזִכָּרוֹן:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת־נֹחַ וְאֵת כָּל־הַחַיָּה וְאֶת־כָּל־הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ בַּתֵּבָה וַיַּעֲבֵר אֱלֹהִים רוּחַ עַל־הָאָרֶץ וַיָּשֹׁכּוּ הַמָּיִם:
עֲשֵׂה פֶלֶא לַחַיִּים. לְבַל יִהְיוּ כַמֵּתִים. הֲיֵשׁ אֲמִתֶּךָ בַּקֶּבֶר לְזִכָּרוֹן: עוֹרַרְתָּ אָז בְּפֹעַל. עוֹרְרֵנוּ בְּלֹא פֹעַל. הֲלֹא לְנִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ תַּעַשׂ לְזִכָּרוֹן:

text: כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ זֵכֶר עָשָׂה לְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְיָ: וְנֶאֱמַר טֶרֶף נָתַן לִירֵאָיו יִזְכֹּר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ:
פְּנֵה אֱלֹהִים. בְּיוֹשְׁבֵי גַנִּים. מַקְשִׁיב לְנִדְבְּרֵימוֹ. בְּרַת לְזִכָּרוֹן: מִפְעָלָם לְפָנֶיךָ. וּשְׂכָרָם אִתְּךָ. אוֹכְלֵי לֶחֶם הָעֲצָבִים. בְּסֵפֶר לְזִכָּרוֹן:

He remembers (Joshua) the son of Nun, and the illuminating words of him who comes from Yephuneh, (Caleb), may they be recalled in prayer so that their deeds should be remembered. When the destructive gleaming sword is drawn for grief, may He hear and remember the supplications of those He has favoured. He remembers the noble judges and the sign given by Samuel at the time of the wheat harvest. He heals the folly of the simple, so that it is no longer remembered. When the destructive gleaming sword is drawn for the four punishments, may He remember the nature of the judgments He gave them. May He remember the hymns of praise in which David, at midnight, praised the rules of the night, may He remember his song in the darkness of the night on their behalf. May He illuminate the nightly search by the fire of the night upon the altar; the law in which they study by day and by night, may He remember for their healing. He remembers the palace that was taken from me on account of my selfishness. May He no longer recall that it was laden with deliberate sins. When anger, as at the time of the flood, is aroused in destruction, let Him remember the month of Bul (the completion of the Temple) in compassion. He re-

text: On Sabbath.
the storm until their destiny arrives and they go forth for remembrance.
As it is written in Thy Torah: ‘God remembered Noah and all the beasts and all the cattle that were with him in the ark and God caused a wind to pass over the earth and the waters subsided’.

Perform wonders for the living lest they become like the dead; is then Thy truth in the grave for remembrance? Once Thou didst pity because of noble deeds; pity us now even though we are without deeds; wilt Thou not make for Thy wonders a remembrance.

As it is written in Thy holy words: ‘A memorial has He made for His wonders, gracious and compassionate is the Lord’. And it was said: ‘He gave food to those that fear Him, He will remember His covenant for ever’.

Turn, O God, to those who sit in the gardens (houses of study), listen how they speak of Thy law for remembrance. Let their work appear before Thee; though they eat the bread of anguish, their reward is with Thee in the book of remembrance.

כָּל פָּעַל. בְּקוֹ וּפֶלֶס יָעַל. וְאִם בְּמֶרֶד וְאִם בְּמַעַל. רַב חֶסֶד יִזְכֹּר: וְאִם טוֹב וְאִם רַע. אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ יֵאָרַע. וּכְמוֹ רִפְשַׂע. כְּסַאסְּאָה מִלִּזְכֹּר: זְכֹר הַחַיִּים. עַד כַּמָּה הֵם חַיִּים. הֵן לְמוֹת אִם לְחַיִּים. חֵי חַי יִזְכֹּר: הֲמוֹן שְׁאוֹן בְּרוּאִים. יַעַבְרוּ לְפָנָיו כִּמְרִיאִים. הֲלֹא כְּמוֹ רְאוּיִים. לְכָל אֶחָד יִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר דַּלּוּת וְעֹשֶׁר. בַּצֹּרֶת וְחֹשֶׁר. דּוֹפִי וְגַם שֵׁר. בְּדִין הוּא יִזְכֹּר: דָּבָר גָּלוּי וְסֵתֶר. בִּנְיוֹנוֹת וְסוֹתֵר. דֵּי חֹסֶר וְיָתֵר. לְקֶצֶב יִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר נְגוּנִים לֵישֵׁב. בְּמִדְבָּר וְיוֹשֵׁב. גֶּשֶׁם וְרוּחַ לְנַשֵּׁב. מֵהַיּוֹם יִזְכֹּר: גָּרוֹן לְהַקְשֵׁב. מֵעַם שְׁמוֹ חוֹשֵׁב. גָּלֻיּוֹת לְהָשֵׁב. בְּיוֹם תָּקַע יִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר בֶּהָל וְחֵמָה. קְרָב
אם שבת.
כַּכָּתוּב עַל־יַד נְבִיאֶךָ אָז נִדְבְּרוּ יִרְאֵי יְיָ אִישׁ אֶל רֵעֵהוּ וַיַּקְשֵׁב יְיָ וַיִּשְׁמָע וַיִּכָּתֵב סֵפֶר זִכָּרוֹן לְפָנָיו לְיִרְאֵי יְיָ וּלְחֹשְׁבֵי שְׁמוֹ:
צָנוּ שׁוּעָלִים. מְחַבְּלִים כְּרָמִים. אֵין כְּרָמִים. לְהַכְרִית מִכַּנּוֹ. שֹׁרֶשׁ וְזִכָּרוֹן: שִׁבְרוּם בְּפָרֶךְ. נָאֲקוּ וְנוֹשָׁעוּ. בְּכֹשֶׁר חָרוּתֵי קֶדֶם. הוּחַק לְזִכָּרוֹן:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶת־נַאֲקָתָם וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת־בְּרִיתוֹ אֶת־אַבְרָהָם אֶת־יִצְחָק וְאֶת־יַעֲקֹב:
קֶדֶם בָּחַנְתָּה לְדוֹרוֹת. אֵין בָּהֶם חֵפֶץ. הֶחֱלַפְתָּם וְאִבַּדְתָּם. מִהְיוֹת לְזִכָּרוֹן: קְהִיתָה דּוֹר מֵאָלֶף. אֲמָרְךָ הַנְחַלְתָּם. לְמַעֲנָם בְּכָל דּוֹר. הֻקַּתָּה לְזִכָּרוֹן:

text: כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ זָכַר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ דָּבָר צִוָּה לְאֶלֶף דּוֹר:

members the test of every creature according to measure and in the scales; when they have committed acts of rebellion and faithlessness, may He remember them, full of compassion. As to the good and the evil whose deeds and way of life should be requited, may He not remember them according to the severity of the law. He remembers life, how long their life shall be; for death or for life He remembers all the living. The noisy throng of creatures passes before Him like lambs; He remembers each according to his worth. He remembers poverty and wealth, need and plenty, vice and virtue; in judgment does He remember. The open and the hidden, building and tearing down, dearth and superfluity, does He measure and remember. He remembers those who should live sheltered in the wilderness or in settlements; to send rain and wind does He remember. To hear the prayer of the people that reveres His Name and to lead back the exiles does He remember on the day of the Tekiah. He recalls terror and wrath, battle and wars; the destruction of
On Sabbath.

As it is written through Thy prophet: ‘Then those who fear God speak one to the other and God listens and hears, and it is inscribed in the book of remembrance before Him on behalf of those who fear the Lord and respect His Name’.

The foxes (Egyptians), the destroyers of vineyards, planned to cut off from the vine its root and remembrance. They oppressed them (Israel) with hardship, they cried out to Thee and were saved because of the piety of the forefathers who had been inscribed for remembrance.
As it is written in Thy Torah: ‘God heard their cry, then God remembered His covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob’.

In days of old Thou didst see generations in whom there was no delight. Thou hast let them vanish and perish without a remembrance. One generation hast Thou chosen from among a thousand and allotted them Thy words; for their sake in every generation hast Thou engraved them for remembrance.
As it is written in Thy holy words: ‘He remembers for ever His covenant, the word He commanded for a thousand generations’.
